paper_metadata.abstract: A test circuit is described for on-wafer monitoring of high-frequency performance of bipolar junction transistors using only dc measurements. The test circuit includes an oscillation-amplitude detector and a high-frequency ( 3 GHz) oscillator whose minimum bias current for oscillation osc correlates strongly with the transistors’ maximum oscillation frequency max. Variations in the circuit’s osc can be routinely monitored to track changes in max caused by process variations. Monte Carlo simulations showed a correlation coefficient of 0.79 between osc and max. Variations in measured max intentionally introduced through Fig. 1. Colpitts oscillator. layout variations were verified to be strongly correlated with osc.
